info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Model Operational Risk Model-spec
info.description: The Operational Risk Model Creation API enables businesses to initiate the creation of operational risk models within the banking sector. This endpoint is designed to support financial institutions in developing and managing sophisticated risk assessment models that comply with regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include risk management teams and financial analysts who need to provide insights into potential operational hazards. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their risk mitigation strategies and improve their overall resilience against operational failures.

post.summary: Create a new operational risk model.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational risk model by submitting the necessary details. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to successfully create the model.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new operational risk model. It requires a JSON object containing all necessary details for the model setup, ensuring that the model adheres to the prescribed structure and validations.
